decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Heavy-set troll with mottled stone-and-lichen skin, a mantle of real flowering moss geometry across the shoulders, a layered bark kilt with a woven belt, and oversized hands and feet with dark claws. Moss and lichen continue across the back and the sole geometry is complete. Rigged: 24-bone humanoid armature, walk and run clips, zero unweighted skinned vertices.
limitations: AI-assisted origin (Meshy) is disclosed upstream; some storefronts require AI-content disclosure.
The moss mantle is skinned to the shoulders and will flex with the torso.
Fingers are static; the 24-bone rig has no finger bones.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Classic grey-alien morphology with an oversized cranium, black almond eyes, slender neck and limbs, long fingers, and a fitted pale suit with recessed panel seams, a belt and integrated boots. Seams continue across the back and the top view confirms the cranial silhouette. Rigged: 24-bone humanoid armature, walk and run clips, zero unweighted skinned vertices.
limitations: AI-assisted origin (Meshy) is disclosed upstream; some storefronts require AI-content disclosure.
The suit reads near-white rather than grey; darken the base colour if you need a darker palette.
Eyes are opaque geometry with no separate cornea.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Twelve-arm bronze chandelier on two tiers with cut-crystal bobeches, candle sleeves and flame-tip bulbs, scrolled arms, a turned central body, a twisted fabric cable and a ceiling cup. Top and bottom views show the full radial arm layout and the underside boss. Crystal and bronze read as distinct materials from every angle.
limitations: Candle bulbs do not emit light by default; add emitters.
Not rigged: arms are fixed and the cable will not sway.
High visual complexity for a real-time ceiling fixture; consider an LOD.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Rounded stoneware jug with a short narrow neck, a rolled lip and a small loop handle from neck to shoulder. Matte stone-white surface with fine speckling, a hollow throat and a closed base with an unglazed foot ring. A worn retail barcode sticker remains on the underside.
limitations: A worn retail barcode sticker is baked into the base texture. No brand name or legible digits remain, but clone it out for product renders where the underside is visible.
Handle is thin geometry and may alias at distance.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. The cabin is a simplified shell without a full dashboard.. Panel gaps, glazing, lamp lenses, wheel arches and the underside floorpan are all modelled, and the top and bottom views confirm a closed body with no missing faces. No brand badge, wordmark or number plate appears anywhere.
limitations: Stylized, not photoreal: this is a Cozy-kit vehicle with a simplified pastel palette.
Wheels are separate objects pivoted on their hubs, so they can be rolled; the body itself is not rigged.
Interior is simplified; not suitable for a close-up cabin shot.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Rubber tyre with a directional block tread, shoulder siping, moulded sidewall ribs and two coloured balance dots. Tread wraps continuously around the circumference and both sidewalls and the inner bead are modelled. Title corrected: the package is a tyre only, with no alloy rim inside it.
limitations: Stylized, not photoreal: this is a Cozy-kit vehicle with a simplified pastel palette.
No wheel rim is included despite the upstream title; pair it with your own rim.
No tyre brand or size lettering is moulded into the sidewall.
